reason: My villa staff throw receipts into Telegram and nobody logs them, and every month I scramble to show my partner where the money went. If the free 40 documents show it really catches a re-sent receipt, $19 or $45 a month is nothing next to one double-paid pool repair.
objection: I don't believe yet that it catches a duplicate when a different staff member re-photographs the same handwritten nota. If it's just turning photos into rows, I can make my assistant do that.
would_change_my_mind: If it misses a duplicate I plant on purpose during the free trial, or the Monday report is too messy to forward to my partner as is, I won't pay.
